raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. institution for higher or professional education, maktab, kolej: teachers’ ~, maktab perguruan; technical ~, maktab teknik; 2. any division or school of a university, kolej: the ~s at Oxford and Cambridge, kolej-kolej di Oxford dan Cambridge; 3. organized body with common profession, duties, etc, kolej: the Royal C ~ of Surgeons, Kolej Diraja Pakar Bedah; electoral ~, badan pemilih.
